verdict.rationale: Slack can be driven without its UI. It has a Web API with 200+ methods, including chat.postMessage. Its official CLI creates and manages apps from the command line, Socket Mode or HTTP endpoints receive Events API callbacks, and webhook triggers start workflows from outside Slack. Free developer sandboxes are available for safe testing. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD guidance (e.g. non-interactive CLI auth or token use in pipelines), any documented headless or CI-mode flag, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
